To:   Board of Directors
      Willow Glen Condominium Association
      c/o Benchmark Community Management
      600 Polaris Parkway, Westerville, OH 43082

RE:   STRUCTURAL ENGINEERING OPINION - BALCONIES, BUILDING C
      Willow Glen Condominiums, 455 Hamilton Way, Gahanna, Ohio

Dear Board Members:

At the request of the Association, Granite Ridge Structural Engineers
performed a visual structural assessment of the twelve (12) cantilevered
wood-framed balconies of Building C on 09/18/2026. This letter presents
our professional opinion regarding their condition and safety. No
destructive testing was performed except for two exploratory openings at
Units C-204 and C-306, made with the owners' consent.

OBSERVATIONS

1. At Unit C-204, the exploratory opening revealed advanced decay at the
   ends of three of the five joists where they pass through the exterior
   wall. A probe penetrated more than 1 inch into the wood. The ledger
   flashing was missing.
2. At Unit C-306, the joists showed surface staining and moisture content
   of 24 percent, but no measurable section loss.
3. At Units C-104, C-208 and C-310, the guardrail posts deflected more
   than 2 inches under a hand-applied lateral load, which exceeds the
   intent of the Ohio Building Code for a 200-pound concentrated load.
4. Several balconies have sloped toward the building, indicating trapped
   water at the wall line.

OPINION

In our professional opinion, the balcony at Unit C-204 is structurally
unsafe and must not be occupied until it is shored or replaced. The
guardrails at C-104, C-208 and C-310 do not provide adequate fall
protection. The remaining balconies show conditions consistent with
long-term water intrusion and should be considered at risk of similar
deterioration.

RECOMMENDATIONS

a) Immediately restrict access to the balcony at C-204 (completed by
   management on 09/19/2026 at our request) and install temporary shoring.
b) Reinforce or replace the deficient guardrail posts at C-104, C-208 and
   C-310 within 30 days.
c) Make exploratory openings at all remaining Building C balconies and
   schedule a follow-up inspection no later than 10/24/2026.
d) Budget for full replacement of the Building C balcony framing with
   proper ledger flashing and a waterproof deck membrane. Our preliminary
   opinion of probable construction cost is $214,000 to $268,000.

This opinion is based on conditions visible on the date of our site
visit and on the limited openings described above. Concealed conditions
may differ. This letter is not a warranty of the structure.

Sincerely,

Kendra L. Vasquez-Ruhl, P.E.
Principal, Ohio P.E. No. 82193
Granite Ridge Structural Engineers, P.C.
